structure.title: Structure
structure.decides: Where responsibilities live and how boundaries and dependencies contain change.
structure.routing: where code lives and how responsibilities are divided: files or folders added, removed or moved, imports across modules, logic that copies or re-implements behaviour existing elsewhere, the same check repeated in several places, a new path that skips a wrapper or check other paths go through, state or call order a caller must remember, a flag parameter that switches a function between behaviours, or a value threaded through several layers

data.title: Data
data.decides: How facts, valid states, ownership and lifetime preserve meaning and invariants.
data.routing: data and its rules: schemas, migrations, the source of truth of a fact, deletion or overwriting of stored records, transactions and invariants, types or fields that decide which states and values can exist, and a domain rule (such as a plan, role or status check) written as branches in several places

contract.title: Contract
contract.decides: What callers may supply, observe and rely on through failure, reruns and concurrency.
contract.routing: what callers may send or receive and how failures reach them: public interfaces, request and response shapes, accepted values and validation, error and failure responses, errors caught, ignored or turned into default values, retries, reruns and concurrency

security.title: Security
security.decides: Which trust boundaries, permissions, dependencies and records protect operations and information.
security.routing: untrusted input handling, secrets and personal data in code or logs, authentication, authorization checks, permissions, exposure, rate limits, or third-party dependencies

ui.title: Ui
ui.decides: How users understand and complete their task through visible states and interactions.
ui.routing: what a person sees or operates on a screen: components, states, transitions, layout, texts shown to users

cost.title: Cost
cost.decides: Which performance, observability, rollout and operational measures justify their cost.
cost.routing: running cost: paid API or model calls, their limits and retries, schedules and frequencies, caches in front of paid calls, instance sizes and counts

test.title: Test
test.decides: Which executable evidence detects failures of the agreed behavior.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.decides: How ordered release units and verification cover the request end to end.

scope.title: Scope
scope.decides: Which changes fulfill the agreed request and preserve affected uses within authority.

readability.title: Readability
readability.decides: Which names, comments, conventions and shared rule definitions make the changed code understandable and keep rules that must change together consistent.

document.title: Document
document.decides: How delivered documents let their intended readers understand, decide and perform the described work.
document.routing: changes to documents people read: READMEs, guides, specifications, design documents, diagrams, or user-facing text files
